reviews.title: 1+ Years Customer - Avoid
reviews.text:
The service from 2Number is terrible.

The signal quality is consistently poor: you often can’t even hear the phone ring.

Even worse, the app frequently blocks you from sending perfectly normal text messages if they contain an email address, LinkedIn profile, or virtually any type of link. It’s baffling how poorly designed this feature is.

On multiple occasions, incoming calls simply never reached me, with no missed call notification or explanation.

To make matters worse, if you pause your subscription, your number is released, meaning you lose it and have to start over with a new one. Their pricing lacks transparency, and customer support is practically non-existent.

I’d recommend avoiding 2Number altogether. There are far better alternatives: I’ve found Quo to be seamless, reliable, and a much better overall experience.
